about: Provenance of the delivered voice-over takes. The MP3 files are byte-identical to what ElevenLabs delivered (sha256 below).
prompt: Five minutes a day, that's all it takes. One word at a time, a streak you'll want to keep alive, a league you'll want to win, and then, one day... you just talk. Languages, math, music... even chess. One path, every skill. Duolingo.
settings: one request, two variations, no direction tags, default voice settings

takes.format: MP3, 44.1 kHz, mono, 128 kb/s, gapless header (1,105-sample encoder delay, trimmed on decode)
